description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the ReportGeneratorService component within the OrangeHRM project. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and verifies methods such as report retrieval, header definition, and data normalization.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ReportGeneratorService functionalities in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating a ReportGeneratorService instance and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testIsPimReport
methods.description: Tests the isPimReport method for existing and non-existing report IDs.

methods.name: testGetHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Verifies header details returned by getHeaderDefinitionByReportId for a specific report ID.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Checks that normalized report data matches expected output for a given report ID.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportDataForPastEmployees
methods.description: Checks normalized report data for past employees for a different report ID.
